name: Prismatic Majordomus
tagline: A lightweight supervisory control layer for AI-assisted work.

commands.name: start
commands.summary: begin a scoped task under a profile

commands.name: check
commands.summary: is the current task consistent with policy, scope, state?

commands.name: finish
commands.summary: evaluate the finish contract; refuse if unmet

commands.name: session
commands.summary: open, inspect and close one execution episode

commands.name: context
commands.summary: what the next worker needs to know now, within budget

commands.name: checkpoint
commands.summary: record compact progress inside the active task

commands.name: handover
commands.summary: write an append-only continuation record (body on stdin)

commands.name: history
commands.summary: read the append-only ledger back

commands.name: decision
commands.summary: record or read durable decisions

commands.name: question
commands.summary: open, resolve and list questions that block acceptance

commands.name: prompt
commands.summary: list, show and render repository-local prompt assets

commands.name: skills
commands.summary: the repository's skills: list, show and check them

commands.name: search
commands.summary: find durable records without reading all of them

commands.name: knowledge
commands.summary: the compiled index over what this repository states

commands.name: rules
commands.summary: the effective rule set: vendored baseline plus project rules   (read-only, except vendor update)

commands.name: plan
commands.summary: the milestone and issue model: validate, read, and move an issue

commands.name: init
commands.summary: create the .ai/ layer in this repository (refuses to overwrite)

commands.name: migrate
commands.summary: move pre-.ai project data from .majordomus/ into .ai/ (explicit, backed up)

commands.name: update
commands.summary: regenerate provider projections from policy

commands.name: doctor
commands.summary: is Majordomus itself healthy and actually wired here?

commands.name: doctrine
commands.summary: what rules are enforced, by what, and whether they are wired

commands.name: watch
commands.summary: what has drifted: state, policy, projections, retention

commands.name: version
commands.summary: print the version

commands.name: bench
commands.summary: time every public command, cold and warm, against the baseline
